deliverables.name: WQA — Website Quality Audit
deliverables.description:
Strategic audit of the website covering technical SEO, content quality, and link foundation.
  · Run Screaming Frog crawl + Ahrefs site explorer pull
  · Classify every page (Keep / Improve / Consolidate / Remove)
  · Tag specific actions per page (Fix 404 / Rewrite / etc.)
  · Capture target pages + their backlink gaps
  · Strategist approval pass on every recommendation
Two outputs (same work stream):
  1. {slug}-wqa-data.xlsx — audit spreadsheet (4 tabs)
  2. {slug}-wqa-report.html — client-facing HTML deck (5 sections)
Auto-completes when BOTH the approvals JSON + HTML report exist on disk.

source.notes: Outputs xlsx audit spreadsheet + HTML client report.

deliverables.name: Analytics Audit — conversion tracking + measurement setup

  · GA4 conversion events — firing reliably, flagged as conversions
  · Call-tracking integrations (WhatConverts / CallRail): DNI, attribution, event push-through
  · Form tracking — submission events, lead source attribution
  · CRM integration (HubSpot / Salesforce / Pipedrive) — sources tagged correctly
  · GA4 ↔ GSC link active
  · Cross-domain / subdomain tracking gaps
  · GBP Insights accessibility
  · Note any tracking holes that would invalidate monthly reports.

Output: short Loom + written summary of what's wired, what's broken, and what needs fixing before Month 1 reporting.
